scene_summary: A closely cropped, naturalistically rendered maid-costume figure leans diagonally across a muted pink ground. A bent bare arm connects a large cracked black puff sleeve to a hand resting at the apron waist. Local source-bearing details include a silver sleeve chain, coral-and-yellow wrist pleats, green-blue undersides beneath pale apron folds, and violet-grained curled hems. The planned material cues are visible, but the composition reads as a detailed figurative portrait rather than a minimal expressionist plate.

detected_objects.label: Bare bent arm connecting the puff sleeve to the hand at the apron waist
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The exposed arm bends sharply at the left elbow, descends toward the pleated cuff, and continues into a hand laid across the pale waistband. Pink ground remains visible inside the bend. The cuff interrupts the skin surface; this polygon maps the connected gesture rather than a uniform material patch.

detected_objects.label: Broad black puff shoulder with fine pale cracking
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A large irregular black sleeve bulges above the torso. Fine branching gray cracks cross its central and upper-right surface, while bright folds gather toward the arm opening. An uneven white ruffle borders the sleeve; the polygon follows the black surface rather than enclosing surrounding skin or background.

detected_objects.label: White wrist pleats over coral folds and yellow lining
detected_objects.visual_evidence: The wrist has a distinct pleated white cuff backed by scalloped muted coral fabric. Thin ochre-yellow lining peeks around the right and lower edges. This is a localized trim feature separate from the hand and apron.

detected_objects.label: Muted green and blue undersides beneath overlapping pale apron folds
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Near the lower-left edge, pale overlapping fabric reveals an olive-green curled underside and a smaller muted blue layer below it. Both colored surfaces visibly belong to stacked folds. Their lower extent is cropped by the image boundary.

detected_objects.label: Short articulated silver chain following the sleeve opening
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Individual reflective oval links form a short curved silver chain between the white arm ruffle and black sleeve. The narrow polygon tracks its arc rather than selecting the entire seam.

detected_objects.label: Pale curled apron hem with violet grain and outlined rolled tip
detected_objects.visual_evidence: A foreground pale fold curls outward into a conspicuous oval rolled end. Lavender-violet shading, fine grain, and narrow purple contour lines run through its interior and hem. The polygon isolates this curled fold from the neighboring green-blue undersides.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The pink ground and single figure keep the overall silhouette readable, and six distinct source-bearing features are visible. However, detailed hair, facial rendering, lace, sleeve cracking, and numerous rolled fabric folds make this a richly rendered portrait rather than a minimal expressionist composition. The chain and colored cuff are small interaction targets. Coverage is an approximate visual estimate.
